title: Why Your Brain Can't Let Go of Unfinished Tasks

visual.description: A man looking intensely at a computer screen with a look of slight frustration or deep focus.

vo.en: That lingering feeling of a half-sent email or a messy desk isn't just annoying; it’s actually mental tension.
vo.fr: Cette sensation d'un mail non envoyé ou d'un bureau encombré n'est pas qu'un détail, c'est une tension mentale.

visual.description: Close up of hands hovering over a keyboard, then suddenly stopping in hesitation.

vo.en: Psychologists call this the Zeigarnik Effect. Your brain keeps these loops open, constantly reminding you to finish them.
vo.fr: C'est l'effet Zeigarnik. Ton cerveau garde ces boucles ouvertes et te les rappelle sans cesse.

visual.description: Abstract digital animation showing connected nodes or a pulsing network representing brain activity.

vo.en: It’s why an unwashed dish feels heavier than it is. Your mind uses precious energy just to track it.
vo.fr: C'est pourquoi une assiette sale semble si lourde. Ton esprit s'épuise juste à la surveiller.

visual.description: Slow motion shot of a single dirty dish in a sink or a cluttered workspace.

vo.en: This background noise drains your focus, making you feel burnt out before you even start working.
vo.fr: Ce bruit de fond gâche ta concentration et t'épuise avant même d'avoir commencé.

visual.description: A man sitting in a dark room rubbing his temples in exhaustion, background lights blurred.

vo.en: The fix is simple: write it down. Offloading the task to paper closes the loop and kills the stress.
vo.fr: La solution ? Écris tout. Poser tes tâches sur papier ferme la boucle et tue le stress.

visual.description: Extreme close up of a hand writing quickly on a notepad with a pen.

vo.en: Stop letting your list haunt you, especially since...
vo.fr: Ne laisse plus ta liste te hanter, surtout parce que...

visual.description: A clock with hands spinning fast or an hourglass with sand running out to symbolize time and loops.
